children.value: Draw living geometry. Protect your Core.

Welcome to Hesset! At the centre of the board sits your CORE — a bright point of light that everything wants to reach. Your defence isn't walls or guns you buy off a shelf: it's geometry you DRAW. Place shapes, connect them with edges, and when your lines close into a loop, the space inside comes alive as a FIELD that fights for you. New here? Pick 🎯 Campaign from the menu — it teaches one shape at a time. This How-to stays here as your cheat sheet.
Controls — place, connect, close the loop

👆 Tap an empty spot to place the shape you have selected. Each placed shape becomes a NODE on the board.
✏️ Drag from one node to another to draw an EDGE between them. Edges are your lines of defence — and the walls of your fields.
🔷 Close a loop — when your edges join up into a ring, the space inside comes ALIVE as a field. This is the heart of the game: loops are power.
💰 Tap Sell, then a shape, to remove it and get some of its cost back.
The shapes — your four building blocks
Every shape does a job on its own, AND changes what a field becomes when it's part of a ring:

△ Spike — your fighter. It shoots at anything hostile in range. Cheap enough to scatter, sharp enough to matter.
□ Anchor — cheap, sturdy structure. Anchors don't attack; they're the affordable corners and walls you build your loops out of.
⬠ Well — makes FLUX, the energy that pays for everything you place. More wells, more to spend. Keep some safe behind your lines.
⬡ Prism — the amplifier. A prism makes the shapes and fields around it stronger. Expensive, but it turns a decent ring into a great one.
Fields — the ring's majority picks its role
When you close a loop, look at the shapes making up the ring. The MAJORITY shape decides what the field inside does:

△ Mostly Spikes → a KILL field — it damages enemies that cross it.
⬠ Mostly Wells → a POWER field — it generates extra flux for you.
□ Mostly Anchors → a BASTION field — tough and defensive, it soaks the hits.
⬡ Mostly Prisms → a RESONANCE field — it amplifies everything it touches.
Want a different role? Reshape the ring — swap a corner, add a node — and the field follows the new majority.
The foes — what's coming for you
Enemies come in waves, and each type attacks your geometry differently:

🪚 Shards — small and vicious, they SAW through your edges. A cut edge breaks the loop, and a broken loop kills the field. Watch your lines.
🔴 Orbs — they ram your NODES head-on. A destroyed node takes every edge attached to it down too.
🪨 Masses — big, slow grinders that push straight for the CORE. If nothing stops them, they'll grind it down. Layer kill fields in their path.
Losing ground? It's usually a broken loop — one sawed edge or one rammed node and the whole field went dark. Between waves, patch your rings before you build new ones.

🎯 Campaign — start here. It introduces one shape at a time, so you learn Spikes before Wells, Wells before Prisms — nothing overwhelming.
♾️ Endless — waves without end, growing harder. How long can your geometry hold?
🧩 Sandbox — free drawing, no enemies. Experiment with loops, majorities and field roles in peace.
Tip: close small loops early. A tiny living field near the Core beats a huge unfinished masterpiece. Good luck — draw well!
